basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University (MGU) has announced 1 vacancy for the Co-Ordinator post on a contract basis for a period of one year. Eligible candidates can apply offline by sending their applications by post to The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam on or before 27 October 2026, with the application process starting on 12 October 2026. Applicants must possess a Ph.D in Food Science and Nutrition/relevant discipline with 15 years experience and 10 publications, and belong to the E/B/T category. The notified pay for the Co-Ordinator post is Rs. 30,000 per month,

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications should be sent by post to reach The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam – 686560 within 15 days from the date of the notification (12 October 2026), making the last date 27 October 2026. Candidates must submit applications on white paper along with self-attested copies of relevant documents to prove qualifications, age, and experience, together with a valid Caste Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate. The application must also include two mobile numbers and an e-mail address. The envelope must be superscribed as “Application for the post of Co-Ordinator on Contract in the School of Food Science and Technology.”

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The candidate should be an eminent scholar with a Ph.D in Food Science and Nutrition or a relevant discipline. Actively engaged in research with a minimum of 10 publications in national or international journals with a high impact factor. Contribution to educational innovations, designing new curriculum and courses, and experience in technology-mediated teaching-learning processes. A minimum of 15 years of teaching experience in a University or college and/or experience in research at University or National level institutions or industries, including experience in guiding students for research at the doctoral level. content_sections.text: The selection of candidates for the Co-Ordinator post will be conducted through an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must belong to the E/B/T category to be eligible to apply. Applications must include a valid Caste Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate. Two mobile numbers and an email address must be provided in the application. Incomplete, defective, or late applications will be summarily rejected. Selected candidates shall enter into a contract for one year with the University.

faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available reserved for the E/B/T category.
